gloss: hand clapping, clapping to a beat

definitions.gloss: hand clapping, clapping to a rhythm or beat
definitions.explanation: Rhythmic clapping of hands, typically done in unison by an audience or group to accompany music, cheering, or traditional celebrations.

examples.japanese: {観客|かんきゃく}が{手拍子|てびょうし}を{打|う}った。
examples.english: The audience clapped along to the beat.

examples.japanese: {手拍子|てびょうし}に{合|あ}わせて{歌|うた}った。
examples.english: We sang along with the hand clapping.

examples.japanese: コンサートの{最後|さいご}に{会場|かいじょう}{全体|ぜんたい}が{手拍子|てびょうし}で{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: At the end of the concert, the entire venue got fired up with rhythmic clapping.

notes:
{手拍子|てびょうし} is rhythmic hand clapping, typically done in unison by a group or audience. Composed of {手|て} (hand) + {拍子|ひょうし} (rhythm, beat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手拍子|てびょうし}を{打|う}つ: to clap along to a beat
- {手拍子|てびょうし}に{合|あ}わせる: to match the clapping rhythm
- {手拍子|てびょうし}で{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる: to get excited with rhythmic clapping
- {手拍子|てびょうし}を{送|おく}る: to send clapping (in support)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Common at concerts, festivals, and traditional celebrations. In Japanese business and celebration culture, {三本締|さんぼんじ}め (three sets of rhythmic claps) and {一本締|いっぽんじ}め (one set) are formal clapping patterns performed at the end of events to mark a successful conclusion.

RELATED WORDS:
- {拍手|はくしゅ}: applause (clapping to show appreciation)
- {拍子|ひょうし}: rhythm, beat
